2610.10411.title: Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds
2610.10411.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.
2610.10411.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼通過使用低成本的草稿模型來加速大型語言模型的推理，該草稿模型提出的標記由全尺寸目標模型並行驗證。並行和半自回歸（semi-AR）草稿器通過在單次前向傳播中提出整個區塊來提高草擬效率，但訓練它們帶來了一個新的困難：給定位置的草稿分佈取決於解碼輪次的開始位置，而輪次的開始取決於早期輪次接受了多少標記。現有的訓練目標通常依賴於忽略這種跨輪次耦合的區塊局部替代品，因此無法直接優化全局解碼效率。在這項工作中，我們通過將推測解碼表示為馬爾可夫獎勵過程來開發一個訓練和評估這些草稿器的理論框架。這一表述產生了期望解碼輪次（EDR）目標，該目標根據狀態佔用權重局部拒絕成本，並且恰好等於期望的解碼輪次數。與先前的替代目標不同，EDR不引入任何輔助超參數。我們然後推導出一個精確的時間差梯度，支持來自目標模型回滾的無偏隨機優化。相同的框架還產生了一個精確的離線評估器，用於輪次計數，使得在共享目標回滾上進行配對草稿器比較，而無需運行推測解碼。使用EDR微調兩個最先進的草稿器，DSpark和DFly，始終提高了平均接受長度，並在數學推理、代碼生成和聊天等九個基準中超越了現有的訓練目標。
